name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The positive recursive teaching bound applies separately to every coordinate trace.
proof: For every S, $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\geq\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})$. Maximize both sides over S.
